lines: That old stretch under the market. I have thought about it since you went out to the gate.
It runs west. It runs straight at your door, and it was laid before anybody here could lay pipe.
Forty years on the mains. I could draw this city blind and get the junctions right.
There is a stretch under the market I did not lay, and my master did not, and his master did not either.

ef_house_b_elder: He gets that from me. I drew half of what he is so proud of.
Do not let him fetch the drawings out unless you have an afternoon spare.
